args.prompt: Handwriting spirals inward. Close on SLOW's notebook page filling with a slow spiral of handwriting; a pigeon lands on the stoop railing. Camera: Over-the-shoulder close. 1990s hand-painted cel anime, warm golden sunrise light, film grain. Keep the art style, characters, faces, hair, outfits and any lettering exactly as in the first frame. Characters do not speak or sing; mouths stay closed or relaxed. No new text or subtitles.
args.negative_prompt: 3D render, CGI, photorealistic, morphing, warped faces, extra limbs, extra people, subtitles, captions, watermark, text changes
